mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Xayah calls all <keywordMajor>Daggers</keywordMajor> back to her and briefly increases her pickup range, dealing <physicalDamage>@BaseDamage@ damage</physicalDamage> for each dagger and <status>Rooting</status> enemies for @RootDuration@ seconds.

Xayah has enhanced pickup range and when she picks up exp or gold, they damage enemy units they pass through dealing @ExpMissileDamage@ or @GoldMissileDamage@ respectively.

When Xayah collects @CastsToProc@ drops she buffs herself, gaining @AbilityHaste@ Ability Haste for @BuffDuration@ seconds. During this time, she also flings a follow up feather dagger when damaging units, dealing @DamagePerHit@ additional damage on hit.
Xayah throws out a dagger infront of her that pierces through enemies, dealing less damage to subsequent enemies and leaves a Dagger in the ground.

Xayah gains @RMoveSpeedPercent*100@% Move Speed and leaps into the air becoming Untargetable and Ghosted for @RUntargetable@ seconds before raining down winged daggers that deal <physicalDamage>@Damage@ damage</physicalDamage> and leave behind a circle of <keywordMajor>Daggers</keywordMajor>.
